social_formats.description: Men dancing in a circle around a central banner.

movement_profile.formation_and_space: A circular formation revolving around a central banner planted in the ground.

signature_moves.description: The ritual act of digging a ceremonial banner into the earth to begin the dance.
signature_moves.name: Banner Planting

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid performing if not a member of the Watal tribe as it is a specific tribal privilege; avoid casual or irreverent behavior near the banner.

music_profile.musical_form: Call and response or unison chorus
music_profile.sound_description: The sound is dominated by the resonant thrum of drums and the synchronized voices of a male chorus. There is a lack of melodic instrumentation, focusing the listener on the rhythmic chanting and the percussive beat that times the dancers' steps.

basic_steps: Approach the central point in a ritual manner
Dig the ceremonial banner into the ground
Form a circle around the banner
Move in a rhythmic circular path while singing in chorus
teaching.level_notes: The dance requires group synchronization and the ability to sing while moving.
teaching.rhythm: Driven by drums and choral singing
